allowances.label: Outdoor electrical outlet (allowance)
allowances.basis: Median 4.25 h of labor (rounded up to the half hour) in quote areas with an outdoor in-use cover or GFCI outlet and at most 3 other products: 27 accepted or presented Livewire quotes (D-Tools, 2024-2026)

allowances.label: New electrical outlet (allowance)
allowances.basis: Livewire Residential 15A Electrical Outlet Package: median 1 h of labor on 160 packages across 124 accepted or presented Livewire quotes (D-Tools, 2024-2026)

allowances.label: Conduit run (allowance)
allowances.basis: By length when given: 0.17 h per foot of conduit run (median of 29 Livewire quote areas with conduit, generator, service and HVAC work left out), at least 6 h; conduit laid in the request's trench runs the trench length per conduit at 0.05 h per foot (outdoor low-voltage conduit runs 0.02-0.10 h/ft) (Henry, 2026-10-15). Median 6 h of labor in quote areas with a conduit run (PVC, EMT or liquid-tight) and at most 3 other products: 14 accepted or presented Livewire quotes (D-Tools, 2024-2026)

allowances.label: Trenching for buried cable (allowance)
allowances.basis: By length when given: 0.083 h per foot of trench (P-791, Livewire's cleanest self-trenched job: 10.4 h for 125 ft; self-trenched areas run 0.046 h/ft including device work), at least 6 h (Henry, 2026-10-15). Median 6 h of labor in quote areas with burial-rated cable or trenching and at most 3 other products: 25 accepted or presented Livewire quotes (D-Tools, 2024-2026)

allowances.label: Low-voltage cable run (allowance)
allowances.basis: Median 2 h of labor in quote areas with a Cat6 Run or Cat6 Retro package and at most 3 other products: 67 accepted or presented Livewire quotes (D-Tools, 2024-2026); the Cat6 Retro package alone carries a median 1.4 h on 83 quotes. One per port or run asked for, and one per wired access point unless the request counts its drops
